title: The merge tool records a past review round for a head that is no longer live
why: Lane reviewed-sends-back (#2177), via the coordinator 11:36 CST Nov 8: `merge --review-record` refuses a head that is not live, so a lane that opens its PR after a fix cannot record a past round with the tool; it hand-posted one through merge.review_body. A hand-written record skips the tool's checks (step record-via-merge-tool).
